text:
maya: T-minus 36h: quick runbook stamp. Can owners confirm SLA, docs, monitoring, pricing table, and oncall roster?
sam: SLA ready for review. Targets: 99.9% uptime, p95 <120ms, p99 <350ms. Credits calc in the pricing sheet.
devin: p99 tail is risky on long sequences. Plan=auto-fallback to trimmed model at 420ms, plus a burn-rate alert at +10% over 1h. Ill add to the runbook and assign owner.
maya: Assign devin as monitoring owner. Please add exact alert names and runbook steps.
alex: Pricing: locking three tiers (starter / pro / enterprise). Starter limits QPS and tokens, pro has burst bucket, enterprise gets reserved capacity + SLA credits. Ill post the final table by EOD.
liz: Docs owner here. Will publish quickstart, troubleshooting, and rollback FAQ. Need sample curl + SDK snippets and a short troubleshooting matrix for latency/noise artifacts.
sam: Oncall: primary + secondary for first 2 weeks post-launch, then normal rotation. Need final roster names 24h before.
maya: Who signs the launch? Ops, Eng, Product, FinOps, Docs. Ill collect signatures via the launch signoff sheet.
alex: FinOps signoff pending final pricing numbers. Ill sign once the table is locked.
devin: Rollout policy proposal: micro-canary at 1% for first 3 hours, 5% next 12h, 25% after 48h. Auto-rollback if error-rate >2% or latency SLO breaches for 15m.
liz: Docs note: include a short customer-facing "what to expect" about cold starts and quantization differences. Also a playbook for customers hitting token limits.
sam: Observability checklist: token-cost dashboard, per-route latency heatmap, sample payload traces, model-version diffs; trace retention = 30d.
maya: Customer comms owner? Need a simple template + FAQ for expected behavior and pricing overage handling.
alex: Sales will coordinate comms; Ill draft a short FAQ and share with sales/AE team.
devin: Add a synthetic prompt set for quality regressions; connect eval alerts to #eng-ml and infra.
maya: Risk: reserved-capacity sizing. We need minimum commit guidance from sales to avoid underprovisioning. @alex can you drive?
alex: Yup, sales + product to define minimums. Ill follow up with Sales lead.
sam: Ill run smoke tests tonight and a small chaos run tomorrow morning. Will post results in this thread.
liz: Draft docs link will be posted here when ready. ETA: EOD today.
maya: Final signoff checklist items: SLA doc, runbook, alert definitions, smoke results, docs published, pricing table, oncall roster. Ill circulate a one-line signoff form T-12h.
ops-bot: Reminder set for 1708504800 (T-24h) to collect final signatures.
devin: Smoke started. Will report back in ~20m.
sam: Thanks everyone 44d
